description: Manage feeds and groups, and read or publish sensor data.

adafruit_io_new_dashboard_trigger.description: Runs for each new Adafruit IO dashboard in Adafruit IO. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, key, name, description

adafruit_io_new_feed_trigger.description: Runs for each new Adafruit IO feed in Adafruit IO. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, key, name, description, visibility, license, enabled

adafruit_io_new_feed_value_trigger.description: Runs for each new feed value in Adafruit IO. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, value, created_at, lat, lon, ele

adafruit_io_new_group_trigger.description: Runs for each new Adafruit IO group in Adafruit IO. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, key, name, description, feeds
